grammar.purpose: Give the location of an action
grammar.explanation: 在 introduces where an action happens: 我在车站等你. The place phrase normally comes before the action verb. Compare 我在车站, where 在 itself states location, with 我在等你, where 在 marks an ongoing action. The following word tells you which use is intended.

examples.py: wǒ zài chē zhàn páng biān děng nǐ .
examples.en: I will wait beside the station.

examples.py: wǒ men zài zhè biān mǎi chē piào .
examples.en: We buy tickets on this side.

commonMistakes.why: Put the location before 等 and its object 你.

grammar.explanation: An ordinary action sentence has a subject and a verb phrase: 我买车票. Time and place can precede the verb: 我八点在车站买票. A yes/no question may use 吗; the action does not need 是. This family concerns action predicates; adjective and nominal predicates have their own patterns.

examples.py: wǒ mǎi chē piào , nǐ děng péng you .
examples.en: I buy tickets; you wait for our friend.

examples.py: péng you zài dà xué zhàn xià chē .
examples.en: Our friend gets off at University Station.

commonMistakes.why: For a neutral statement of the action, do not insert 是 before 买. Contextual emphatic 是 has a different use.

grammar.purpose: Read a complete appointment date and time
grammar.explanation: Write a date from larger units to smaller: 二零二六年十月六日. 年 is read digit by digit; 〇 in a year is líng. 日 is formal; 号 is common in speech. A weekday uses 星期 plus 一 to 六, or 日/天 for Sunday. Clock time puts 点 before minutes: 八点零五分. 半 means half past, so 八点半 is eight thirty. Use 二 in 二零二六年 but 两 in 两点.

examples.zh: 二零二六年十月六日，星期二。
examples.py: èr líng èr liù nián shí yuè liù rì , xīng qī èr .
wǒ men bā diǎn líng wǔ fēn jiàn miàn .
examples.en: Let us meet at eight oh five.

examples.py: xīng qī rì liǎng diǎn bàn shàng chē .
examples.en: Board on Sunday at half past two.

commonMistakes.why: Say the hour before the minutes.

dialogue.title: Which side of the station?
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the agreed meeting point and time.

lines.zh: 我们星期二八点在车站见面，好吗？
lines.py: wǒ men xīng qī èr bā diǎn zài chē zhàn jiàn miàn , hǎo ma ?
lines.en: Shall we meet at the station on Tuesday at eight?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 十月六号，八点零五分吧。我要先买车票。
lines.py: shí yuè liù hào , bā diǎn líng wǔ fēn ba . wǒ yào xiān mǎi chē piào .
lines.en: On 6 October, at eight oh five. I need to buy a ticket first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。你现在在什么地方？
lines.py: hǎo . nǐ xiàn zài zài shén me dì fāng ?
lines.en: Okay. Where are you now?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 在车上，下一站是大学站，我在那里下车。
lines.py: zài chē shàng , xià yī zhàn shì dà xué zhàn , wǒ zài nà lǐ xià chē .
lines.en: On the vehicle. The next stop is University Station; I will get off there.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我在路上，还有五分钟。你在路口等吗？
lines.py: wǒ zài lù shàng , hái yǒu wǔ fēn zhōng . nǐ zài lù kǒu děng ma ?
lines.en: I am on the way, another five minutes. Will you wait at the junction?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不，路口的马路上车多。我在车站旁边等。
lines.py: bù , lù kǒu de mǎ lù shàng chē duō . wǒ zài chē zhàn páng biān děng .
lines.en: No, there is heavy traffic at the junction. I will wait beside the station.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 是在这边还是那边？
lines.py: shì zài zhè biān hái shi nà biān ?
lines.en: Is it on this side or that side?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 出口这边，旁边有商店，这个地方很好找。
lines.py: chū kǒu zhè biān , páng biān yǒu shāng diàn , zhè gè dì fāng hěn hǎo zhǎo .
lines.en: On the exit side, next to a shop. This place is easy to find.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我看到一辆蓝色汽车，是你的车吗？
lines.py: wǒ kàn dào yī liàng lán sè qì chē , shì nǐ de chē ma ?
lines.en: I can see a blue car; is it yours?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是。我走这条路过来，你别在马路上等。
lines.py: bù shì . wǒ zǒu zhè tiáo lù guò lái , nǐ bié zài mǎ lù shàng děng .
lines.en: No. I am walking along this road to you; do not wait in the road.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我下车后先买两张车票。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ xià chē hòu xiān mǎi liǎng zhāng chē piào .
lines.en: Okay. After getting off, I will buy two tickets first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，我们八点半再一起上车。
lines.py: xíng , wǒ men bā diǎn bàn zài yì qǐ shàng chē .
lines.en: Okay. We will get on together at eight thirty.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 二零二六年十月六日，星期二，我们去见朋友。
lines.py: èr líng èr liù nián shí yuè liù rì , xīng qī èr , wǒ men qù jiàn péng you .
lines.en: On Tuesday, 6 October 2026, we are going to meet a friend.

lines.zh: 先在大学站下车，八点零五分在车站旁边见面。
lines.py: xiān zài dà xué zhàn xià chē , bā diǎn líng wǔ fēn zài chē zhàn páng biān jiàn miàn .
lines.en: Get off at University Station first; meet beside the station at eight oh five.

lines.zh: 现在七点五十分，我在车上，朋友在路上。
lines.py: xiàn zài qī diǎn wǔ shí fēn , wǒ zài chē shàng , péng you zài lù shàng .
lines.en: It is seven fifty now. I am on the vehicle; my friend is on the way.

lines.zh: 路口的马路上车很多，不在路口等。
lines.py: lù kǒu de mǎ lù shàng chē hěn duō , bù zài lù kǒu děng .
lines.en: There are many vehicles on the road at the junction; do not wait there.

lines.zh: 出口这边有商店，我们在这个地方等。
lines.py: chū kǒu zhè biān yǒu shāng diàn , wǒ men zài zhè gè dì fāng děng .
lines.en: There is a shop on the exit side; we will wait at this place.

lines.zh: 那边有一辆蓝色汽车，不是朋友的车。
lines.py: nà biān yǒu yī liàng lán sè qì chē , bù shì péng you de chē .
lines.en: There is a blue car over there; it is not our friend’s.

lines.zh: 这条路不长，走五分钟就到。
lines.py: zhè tiáo lù bù zhǎng , zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào .
lines.en: This road is short; it is five minutes on foot.

lines.zh: 我先买两张车票，八点半我们再一起上车。
lines.py: wǒ xiān mǎi liǎng zhāng chē piào , bā diǎn bàn wǒ men zài yì qǐ shàng chē .
lines.en: I will buy two tickets first; we will get on together at eight thirty.

questions.q: Is the blue car their planned transport?
choices: No, it is not their friend’s car
Yes, it belongs to the writer
Yes, it is a taxi they booked
questions.answer: No, it is not their friend’s car

lines.zh: 我在这边。你在哪边？
lines.py: wǒ zài zhè biān . nǐ zài nǎ biān ?
lines.en: I am over here. Which side are you on?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 在车站旁边，不在路口。
lines.py: zài chē zhàn páng biān , bù zài lù kǒu .
lines.en: Beside the station, not at the junction.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那辆汽车是你的车吗？
lines.py: nà liàng qì chē shì nǐ de chē ma ?
lines.en: Is that car yours?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是。先下车，走到出口这边。
lines.py: bù shì . xiān xià chē , zǒu dào chū kǒu zhè biān .
lines.en: No. Get off first, then walk to this side of the exit.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这条路上车很多，我先等红灯。
lines.py: zhè tiáo lù shàng chē hěn duō , wǒ xiān děng hóng dēng .
lines.en: There is heavy traffic on this road; I will wait at the red light first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，安全一点。八点零五分见面，八点半再上车。
lines.py: hǎo , ān quán yī diǎn . bā diǎn líng wǔ fēn jiàn miàn , bā diǎn bàn zài shàng chē .
lines.en: Good, stay safe. Meet at eight oh five and board at eight thirty.
lines.speaker: b

choices: No, waiting at the red light is accepted
Yes, the friend says to run
